title: On transposed Poisson conformal superalgebras
summary: We introduce and study transposed Poisson conformal superalgebras, the $\mathbb Z_2$-graded conformal analogues of transposed Poisson algebras, as well as their noncommutative variants. We derive a family of identities forced by the transposed conformal super-Leibniz rule and prove that the tensor product over $\mathbb C[\partial]$ of two such superalgebras again carries a natural transposed Poisson conformal superalgebra structure.
